verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes OpenAPI-compliant spec files and importable Postman collections for its REST/SQL APIs, which gives developers a way to run example requests, but there is no evidence of an embedded, interactive 'try-it' API reference on the docs site itself — a direct probe for openapi.json/swagger endpoints returned 404s. Missing for 10: an in-browser interactive API explorer (e.g., Swagger/Redoc UI) hosted by Snowflake, and any independent confirmation that the Postman-based workflow is commonly used as a live API reference.
